verdict.rationale: Airweave exposes a documented REST API (OpenAPI spec), a CLI for search, webhooks for event-driven automation, and a self-hostable deployment (docker/start.sh) — all of which support headless/automatable use outside a UI. However, there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation, headless auth/config-as-code examples, or CI-specific guidance in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline examples, headless credential/config automation docs, independent confirmation of running Airweave in CI.
